title: Re-verify the licensing matrix (licenses/policies change)
context: Periodic re-verification of the cancer-source licensing & access matrix, because licenses and access policies change over time. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Depends on license-matrix-005; any newly-restrictive change must be propagated to the gate and policy.
objective: Re-verify every source disposition in the licensing matrix against current cited clauses/URLs and record any changes with dates.
acceptanceCriteria: Each source disposition re-checked against the current license URL + clause; the matrix version and re-verification date are bumped.
Any change in tier or derivative-permission is recorded and propagated to gate-004 / policy-006; newly-restrictive sources are flagged/excluded.
COSMIC/OncoKB and controlled tiers remain flagged/out-of-scope; no source is silently promoted to open without a cited clause.
